about: 33 cross-paper probes over the 10 battery papers of runs/papers-corpus, written 2026-10-21 from the papers' extracted text and the verified keys of bench-leads and bench-multistep, before any run. Questions never name a paper. cat: W which paper, C compare, K count across papers, H chain across papers, X computation across papers, A absence across the corpus, F false premise. papers: the papers the answer needs. must / must_not as in bench-leads (NEG = any absence wording). Frozen by frozen.sha256 before the first run.

probes.q: One of the papers reports a 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell that kept 65.7% of its initial capacity. Which paper, after how many cycles, and at what charge/discharge rates?
probes.expect: cssc-2020 ('Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials'): 1000 cycles at 1C/2C (p2.L99-101)

probes.q: Which paper measures the sodium nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors, and how much does a carbon layer lower it?
probes.expect: nanolett-6b05174 ('Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal'): from 19 mV (bare Al) to 12 mV (carbon/Al) (p2.L58-62)

probes.q: Which paper estimates how much cobalt would be needed to build a million electric vehicles with different cathodes, and what does it give for NMC 111 and for NMC 811/NCA?
probes.expect: adma-2020 (LiNixFeyAlzO2, NFA): ≈2500 tons for NMC 111, ≈700 tons for NMC 811 and NCA, none for NFA (BatPaC; 260 miles) (p2.L84-104)

probes.q: Which paper gives the projected size of the Li-ion battery recycling market in 2025 and 2030, and what are the figures?
probes.expect: mattod-2020 (Battery Identity Global Passport review): $12.2 billion (2025) to $18.1 billion (2030), CAGR 8.2% (p2.L57-59)

probes.q: In which paper did a recycled cathode material keep 92.67% of its baseline capacity, and after how many cycles at what rate?
probes.expect: susmat-2020 (Cyrene-based separation): 158.0 mAh/g after 40 cycles at C/3, 92.67% of the baseline (p6.L23-29)

probes.q: Which paper measured the residual moisture of water-processed and NMP-processed NMC532 cathodes, and what were the values at 20 °C?
probes.expect: ensm-2020 (roll-to-roll manufacturing perspective): 625 ppm (water) and 200 ppm (NMP) at 20 °C (p8.L53-55)

probes.q: Which paper locks strain into a battery-electrode film by coating it on superelastic NiTi wires, and what axial strains were applied to the wires?
probes.expect: acsnano-7b02404 ('Tunable Mechanochemistry of Lithium Battery Electrodes'): 5% and 10% (0-10% range) on V2O5 coatings (p3.L4-7, p3.L19-20)
probes.trap: the <2% strain on the V2O5 itself

probes.q: Which paper tabulates the Li-ion diffusivities of coating materials, and which coating material in that table has the highest diffusivity?
probes.expect: ensm-2021 ('Valuation of Surface Coatings...'): Table 5; TiO2 (rutile), 1 x 10^-6 cm^2/s (p14.T5 r15)

probes.q: Two of the papers build sodium cells with NaPF6 dissolved in a glyme. Which glyme does each use?
probes.expect: the room-temperature Na-S paper (nanolett-6b05172): tetraglyme (p5.L34-41); the anode-free sodium paper (nanolett-6b05174): 1 M NaPF6 in diglyme (p2.L31-33)

probes.q: Two papers recover cathode material from NMC622 electrodes or scraps with an organic solvent at 100 °C. Name each solvent and how long the separation took at 100 °C.
probes.expect: ethylene glycol (cssc-2020): less than 2 min at 100 °C (p3.L132-134); Cyrene (susmat-2020): stirred at 100 °C for 1 h (p3.L14)
probes.trap: EG's seconds at 160 °C or at its boiling point

probes.q: What happens to the PVDF binder in each of the two solvent-based recovery processes, the ethylene glycol one and the Cyrene one?
probes.expect: EG: PVDF is not removed or dissolved, it stays with the cathode material (cssc-2020 p5.L71-73); Cyrene: PVDF dissolves at ~100 °C and is separated from the cathode powder by hot filtration (susmat-2020 p4)

probes.q: Three papers report lithium leaching from nickel-containing NMC cathodes into a liquid. Which liquid in each, and which of them gives a number for the leaching in the main text?
probes.expect: ethylene glycol (cssc-2020): Li content 1.015 to 0.993 (p5.L65-68); Cyrene (susmat-2020): ether groups attract lithium, numbers only in Table S1, not in the text (p5.L19-26); water (ensm-2020): NMC 811 leached ~3 wt% Li after one week (p5.L62-63)

probes.q: What cell cost target from the US Department of Energy does one paper cite, what battery cost in 2020 does another give, and how far apart are they?
probes.expect: DOE cell cost target $80/kWh (ensm-2020 p1-2); around $130/kWh in 2020 (aenm-2022 p13.L19-22): $50/kWh above the target

probes.q: Of the two solvent-recovery papers, which tested its recovered cathode only in half cells, leaving full cells for future work, and which reports a pouch cell?
probes.expect: Cyrene paper (susmat-2020): half cells only, full-cell test future work (p6.L33-35); EG paper (cssc-2020): 1.4 Ah pouch cell, 65.7% after 1000 cycles (p2.L99-101)

probes.q: How many of the papers are about sodium batteries rather than lithium batteries, and which are they?
probes.expect: 2: the room-temperature sodium-sulfur battery (nanolett-6b05172) and the anode-free sodium battery (nanolett-6b05174)

probes.q: How many of the papers mention the solvent Cyrene, and which?
probes.expect: 2: susmat-2020 (the Cyrene separation study) and mattod-2020 (the recycling review, which cites it as ref. 129)

probes.q: How many of the papers mention Argonne's BatPaC battery cost model, and which?
probes.expect: 3: adma-2020 (cobalt per million EVs), aenm-2022 (pack and material cost of Co-free vs NCA), ensm-2020 (cell cost target)

probes.q: The recycling review says one solvent delaminates cathode films from aluminum foil 'in seconds' without corroding the foil. Which solvent, and how long does delamination take at that solvent's boiling point according to the research paper that reports it, and what is that boiling point?
probes.expect: ethylene glycol (mattod-2020, ref. 121); around 2 s at the boiling point, 198 °C (cssc-2020 p3.L129-138)

probes.q: The recycling review cites a bio-derived green solvent that reclaims cathode material, aluminum foil and PVDF from cathode scraps. Which solvent, and above what temperature does DSC show PVDF dissolving in it in the paper that reports the study?
probes.expect: Cyrene (mattod-2020 ref. 129); ~90 °C (susmat-2020 p4.L24)

probes.q: The LiNixFeyAlzO2 (NFA) cathodes are introduced in one paper and revisited in a 2022 review. Which NFA variant kept the most capacity after 100 cycles in the original paper, and what capacity retention does the review report for 0.5 Ah NFA/graphite pouch cells?
probes.expect: NFA-A (15% Al), ≈80% after 100 cycles (adma-2020 p10.L49); 72% after 200 cycles at C/3 (aenm-2022 p8.L7-9)

probes.q: The roll-to-roll manufacturing perspective lists a cobalt-free NFA cathode technology in its Table 1. What energy density does it estimate for it, and what first-cycle discharge capacity does the original NFA paper report for its lowest-capacity variant?
What share of a Li-ion cell's weight does the recycling review give for active cathode materials such as NMC622, and what first charge capacity did the NMC622 recovered with Cyrene deliver?
probes.expect: around 30% (mattod-2020 p3.L47-49); 194.0 mAh/g (susmat-2020 p6.L20-21; baseline 205.6)

probes.q: By how many mAh/g does NFA 811's first-cycle discharge capacity in the NFA paper exceed the practical capacity of LiFePO4 given in the 2022 cobalt-free review?
By how much does the anode-free sodium cell's energy density exceed the upper end of the highest estimate in the roll-to-roll perspective's Table 1?
How much higher is the first charge capacity of the NMC622 recovered with Cyrene than the practical capacity of LiCoO2 given in the 2022 cobalt-free review?

The 2022 cobalt-free review estimates how much cobalt is usable for batteries from known reserves. How many fleets of one million EVs with NMC 111 cathodes could that supply, using the NFA paper's estimate of the cobalt one such fleet needs?
probes.expect: ~2 million metric tons (aenm-2022 p1.L42-47) / ≈2500 tons per million EVs (adma-2020 p2.L93-96) = ~800 fleets

probes.q: Which of the papers gives a price for Cyrene, per kilogram or per liter?
probes.expect: none: Cyrene appears only in susmat-2020 and once in mattod-2020, with no price

probes.q: What cost per kilogram of recovered cathode material do the papers give for the ethylene glycol delamination process?
probes.expect: none: cssc-2020 calls it cost-effective but gives no cost; the review gives none for it

probes.q: What capacity retention did a full cell built with the NMC622 recovered by Cyrene show?
probes.expect: not reported: only half cells were tested; the full-cell test is future work (susmat-2020 p6.L33-35)

probes.q: Why do both sodium-battery papers use carbonate electrolytes with their sodium metal?
probes.expect: premise false: both use NaPF6 in glymes (tetraglyme; diglyme); the Na-S paper chose the glyme to avoid the unstable SEI that carbonates form on Na metal (nanolett-6b05172 p5.L34-41)

probes.q: Since both solvent-recovery papers dissolve the PVDF binder, how does each one recover it?
probes.expect: premise false: ethylene glycol does not dissolve PVDF (cssc-2020 p5.L71-73); only Cyrene does (susmat-2020)

probes.q: Why does the 2022 cobalt-free review say the NFA/graphite pouch cells failed before 100 cycles?
probes.expect: premise false: 0.5 Ah NFA/graphite pouch cells kept 72% after 200 cycles at C/3 (aenm-2022 p8.L7-9)

probes.q: How badly does ethylene glycol corrode the aluminum foil during delamination, according to the papers?
probes.expect: premise false: it does not corrode the foil (shiny foils, only Al by XRD; cssc-2020 p3.L114-124; the review: 'nor corroding the Al foil', mattod-2020); water is what corrodes Al
